name: Digital Lending — New Lending Obligation Requires Review
sourceDocument: PROJECT-DEFINED SAFETY-NET RULE — not a specific numbered RBI clause
confidenceNote: DL-03 is a project-defined REVIEW rule. It sends new lending obligations for human review and does not claim to implement a specific RBI clause.
clauseText: Not applicable — see confidenceNote. This rule's rationale is internal project policy, not a quoted regulatory clause.
observableGraphCondition: Any Obligation present in GraphDelta.addedObligations (new lending obligation not present in the approved baseline).
implementationNotes: This is a REVIEW trigger, not a BLOCK — the human reviewer decides whether the specific obligation terms are permissible.

New obligations always trigger REVIEW even if the creditor is an approved partner. The human reviewer must confirm that the specific obligation terms (tenor, installments, feeBps) were part of the approved engagement.
This rule does NOT duplicate DL-02: DL-02 checks whether the actor exists in the registry; DL-03 checks whether the specific obligation (with its financial terms) is in the approved baseline.
Regulatory conclusions remain the responsibility of the human reviewer.
